results.name: R1 two open windows cannot silently overwrite each other
R1b the second window can take over; the first one then stops and its data is not reused
R2 a failed read at start never turns into an empty app that overwrites data
R3 a damaged backup is rejected before it replaces anything (incl. category loops)
R4 folder copy: notes or categories with the same name do not overwrite each other
R5 after stopping "Ask AI again", a second "Ask AI again" works
R6 copy & paste mode: Stop always ends the run; background is blocked while a window is open
R7 splitting with --- keeps the right original for each part
R8 deleting a note during a run leaves no orphan items or tasks
R9 a storage write that aborts is reported, not left hanging
R10 guardrails catch changed meaning (negation, numbers, short rewrites) but allow heavy typo fixes
R11 tasks: invented tasks are flagged; "done" needs a sign in the note
R12 splitter: lines of one paragraph can become separate items; ----- always separates
R13 questions step reads every note fully (long notes, many notes)
R14 a long note gets a big enough AI context (not cut off)
R15 folder/Markdown files match the screen (tagged notes, linked tasks)
R17 privacy: backups do not contain the API key; restoring keeps this PC's AI address; remote/cloud AI is warned about
R18 unfinished edits and half-answered questions are not lost silently; setup explains installing Ollama
